name: Vital Assistant
summary: Ask for a command. It runs only after you confirm.
description: Vital Assistant answers questions about this system from the terminal (vital ask) and from a window opened with Super+Shift+A. The default provider is xAI Grok using a key you create at console.x.ai. OpenAI-compatible endpoints and a local Ollama install are also supported. The key is stored in the system keyring and is never written to a file or sent to vital-os.org. Prompts are not part of Vital OS telemetry. This package is installed on the image. Marketplace can update it after the SHA-256 of the package matches, and Remove uninstalls the command, the window, the shell hook, and the shortcut.
